In this role, you will leverage data, forecasting models, and business insights to drive planning decisions, improve supply readiness, and support product lifecycle management. You will work across Product Management, Supply Chain, Sales, Finance, and Operations teams to provide actionable recommendations, develop reporting solutions, and help advance AMD's transition to AI-enabled planning platforms. THE PERSON: The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and a passion for solving complex operational challenges. You are data-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. You excel in a collaborative environment and can effectively communicate insights to both technical and business stakeholders. Partner with cross-functional teams to support product ramps, lifecycle transitions, and supply readiness initiatives. Identify demand and supply imbalances, evaluate business impacts, and provide data-driven recommendations to mitigate risks and constraints. Develop and maintain dashboards, reporting solutions, forecasting models, and performance metrics to support business decision-making. Leverage AI-enabled analytics and planning tools to improve forecasting accuracy, operational visibility, and planning efficiency. Support the implementation and adoption of next-generation planning platforms through process analysis, requirements gathering, and cross-functional coordination. Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders, enabling timely and informed business decisions. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience in business analysis, supply chain analytics, operations planning, product planning, or related business functions. Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience in forecasting, trend analysis, and data modeling. Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using business intelligence and data visualization tools. Familiarity with supply chain, demand planning, inventory management, or product lifecycle processes. Experience working with AI-enabled analytics, planning systems, or advanced data modeling techniques. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights. Semiconductor, technology, or manufacturing industry experience preferred. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
